name: Golo
title: Archer, Hunter & Artifact Bearer
subtitle: Half-Giant / Half-Centaur Archer
summary: A powerful centaur master archer and hunter who channels ice and fire runes through a d12-shaped artifact and bears the Hammer of Earthshatter.
details: Half-Giant / Half-Centaur archer, hunter, and artifact bearer.

powers.name: Ice & Fire Runes
powers.description: Channels activated ice and fire runes connected to the d12-shaped object in his saddlebag. Each rune has its own daily uses.

powers.name: Master Archer & Rune-Charged Arrows
powers.description: Uses practiced mastery to strike with his bow. He may spend a daily ice or fire rune use to charge an arrow with that power.
powers.usesRange: Rune-charged arrows spend the chosen rune use

powers.name: Hammer of Earthshatter
powers.description: Instantly explodes or powders a 10-foot radius of non-living stone, including non-living spirit-conjured rock.

relationships: Trusted by the dwarves as artifact bearer and rune licensee. Butcher's Guild bond established through the Iceman connection.
specialRules: Earthshatter affects non-living stone and rock conjurations, but does not directly destroy living creatures.

inventory.name: D12-Shaped Rune Object
inventory.charges: Activated golden, ice, and fire runes; carried in saddlebag

sessionNotes: The Hammer of Earthshatter has a pulse in its core that Golo can sense as he works with it and strikes with it. The hammer seems drawn toward the mountains.
